result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is CBOR as the wire serialisation format, because it makes more sense for our data structures.

The record behind that is decision #17, and it is still active. I didn't run `muninn show` on #15, but the memory query returned an earlier note, #15 ("msgpack for everything"). It is only a session excerpt, not a decision record, and #17 came after it, so I left it out as retired.

The `muninn why` query said "sufficient", but on the strength of #5 (zstd compression), which is a different subject. Its result doesn't say directly that #17 outranks #15. I relied on #17's later id and its status as a decision record.

The `mkdir` and heredoc command first failed with a parser error, so I wrote the file with the Write tool instead.

Muninn also flagged a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That doesn't affect this file, but the hook timeouts may need checking (`.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`).
